concept.internal_detail: tightly wound clockwork barrels and miniature brass push-rods
concept.button: a flush brass toggle switch at the tapered tail
concept.shell_mechanic: The slender teardrop housing parts down the centerline and the metallic shell halves fold outward like opening wings
